anchors: Physical fractions 0..1 are preference assumptions, not engineering pass thresholds; infrastructure keeps existing 0..2000 km anchor

model_assumptions: Each source dated mine-plan design forecast, not operating performance
Compare whole-feed oxide recovery and concentrate oxide grade; no extrapolation to all deposits or to separated oxides
Different mineral assemblages are background mechanisms, not numerical bonuses
Only one explicitly typed engineering design case per project; competing cases excluded rather than selecting maximum or newest

TPR.quantity: TREO mass recovered in mineral concentrate / TREO in whole ore

dependency_audit: Grade and recovery have distinct numerators/denominators; no enrichment, contained resource or product tonnage included. Same-source errors dependent and unquantified; no independent measurement noise drawn. Study maturity not scored. Both cases have equal existing D1=0.6; it contributes no discrimination. Do not interpret D1 weighting as independent validation quality. GIS comparison excluded where Yangibana has no selected representative point; no zero imputation.
reference_scope: Existing development study maturity score, fixed at source DFS design in both named cases; invariant context not Technical performance or evidence-quality bonus
uncertainty: NO_SOURCE_MEASUREMENT_BOUNDS; deterministic scope scenarios; existing seeded weight Monte Carlo only, not success probability
